items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Dave Dexter brought in Red Nichols to play in my place, you know.

ctx.x: Well, I remember the (?) in Hollywood, "Hollywood Stampede" I think they called it -- [SINGS 4 BARS]; I remember that. And I remember... It was nice. I thought it came out very nice. I saw the picture a couple of times, too, since they made it.

But right after that is when we went into the studio at Capitol Records. Dave Dexter brought in Red Nichols to play in my place, you know. When they started rehearsing it down, he didn't have the slightest idea what he was supposed to be playing. So he really couldn't play it. So Oscar
